description: Send a free-trial inquiry for a free class after the user confirms the details. Not for paid classes; never resend an inquiry the user already sent. Returns the inquiry intent ID and submission status.

branch_slug.description: Public club slug returned by search_clubs; this is not a branch UUID.
branch_slug.title: Branch Slug

date_of_birth.description: The inquirer's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD, supplied in the secure inquiry form.
date_of_birth.title: Date Of Birth

email.description: The signed-in account's email address; inquiries cannot use another person's email.
email.title: Email

first_name.description: First name supplied by the person making the free trial inquiry.
first_name.title: First Name

language.description: Preferred supported language code, such as en, de, es, fr or pl.
language.title: Language

last_name.description: Last name supplied by the person making the free trial inquiry.
last_name.title: Last Name

note.description: Optional inquiry message supplied by the user; send an empty string if absent.
note.title: Note

occurrence_key.description: Exact class occurrence key returned by the public or member class schedule.
occurrence_key.title: Occurrence Key

phone.description: Phone number supplied by the inquirer for the club to contact them.
phone.title: Phone

request_id.description: Optional retry identifier. Reuse it when retrying the same confirmed inquiry; never resubmit a completed inquiry.
request_id.title: Request Id

name: submit_free_trial_inquiry
title: Submit a free trial inquiry
